headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 10-2, behind Derek Hill's 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Samuel Basallo leading the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Atlanta Braves due to left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins have transferred Anthony Banda from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left lat strain. The Athletics have placed Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 10, 2026, due to a right thumb capsule sprain. The Pittsburgh Pirates have transferred Konnor Griffin from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left ring finger sagittal back injury.

Several teams have made roster moves in recent days. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Matt Seelinger to the New York Mets for cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 10-2. Derek Hill led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 0-4 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, marking a tough outing for the team. JJ Bleday led the Cubs' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Hunter Greene dominated on the mound for the Reds, striking out 12 batters in 7 innings.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Braxton Ashcraft led the Pirates' pitching effort, while William Contreras and Jake Bauers had standout performances for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged the Los Angeles Angels 5-3, securing a crucial win. Impact players for the Twins included Royce Lewis, while Joe Ryan led the pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Mike Yastrzemski on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves left fielder Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates. In return, the White Sox acquired LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
